A-10     SERVICE SPECIFICATIONS — Cooling System, Lubrication System, Ignition System

COOLING SYSTEM

Radiator

STD: 0.75 — 1.05 kg/cm² | 10.7 — 14.9 psi | 74 — 103 kPa

Thermostat

Start to open at: 86 — 90°C | 187 — 194°F
Fully opens at: 100°C | 212°F
Valve opening travel at 100°C (212°F): 8 mm | 0.31 in.
